name: wespa_word_wars
notes: WESPA Word Wars (Nigel Richards vs Adam Logan, Albany Marriott NY), YouTube broadcast "Nigel Richards vs Adam Logan - Wespa Word Wars Games 1-7". Corners validated against Game 1 move 2 (board showing QAT/HUIA aligned correctly). Noted as slightly off for a later, busier Game 2 frame (top-left corner cut off) -- not yet re-calibrated for that case; re-verify before trusting on a new frame from later in a game. | occupancy_diff_threshold/occupancy_gradient_threshold tuned 2026-07-25 against a real empty-board frame (t=5053s in the YojCdbthGQY broadcast, start of Game 2, both clocks at 25:00): the NASPA-tuned defaults (25.0/100.0) caused 47/225 real empty cells to spuriously score as occupied, because WESPA premium squares carry visible printed text ("DOUBLE LETTER SCORE" etc) that the original thresholds never had to reject. These tuned values got that down to 12/225 while staying safely below every observed real-tile score on this one frame -- re-verify against a fresh real frame before fully trusting them. reference_board_path is a SESSION-SCRATCHPAD path, not committed to the repo (real broadcast photo, same copyright policy as every other real photo here) -- recreate it (rectify a real, unoccluded, tile-free frame with this profile's calibration()) if this exact path no longer exists.
